def B(c):
    return ZZ(1) if bool(c) else ZZ(0)
instances = [
    oracle_instance('0', '0',
                    lhs=RIF(0),
                    rhs=RIF(0), relation='<=', edge=True),
    oracle_instance('2', '1',
                    lhs=RIF(abs(-2*sin(1)+3)),
                    rhs=RIF(5), relation='<=', edge=False),
    oracle_instance('-1', '-3',
                    lhs=RIF(abs(sin(-3)+27)),
